asset_origin: Bed center at floor level; Blender meters converted to glTF Y-up
source_model: HRA male v24 patient and fitted Portex SACETT 100/189/080

lod3.meaning: patient hidden; building and status only

runtime_visibility_hints.room_portal_culling: Hide the interior unless the camera is in the room or a visible open portal sees it.
runtime_visibility_hints.occlusion_culling: Optional after profiling; frustum culling does not hide objects behind walls.
runtime_visibility_hints.distance_detail_culling: Hide subpixel ETT accessories and ventilator details at floor scale.
runtime_visibility_hints.distance_thresholds: Choose in the viewer from projected size and room visibility; no fixed distances calibrated yet.

shared_state.clinical_status: illustrative virtual baseline, not verified real admission

limitations.browser_lod_switching: GLBs exported; runtime switching and room culling not installed.
limitations.head_angle: Detailed LODs aligned at 0 degrees; head articulation needs a deformation rig.
limitations.lod1_blanket: Portable settled mesh; complete close-up scene asset retains baked cloth physics.
